title: Losing the controller while halted safe-stops no earlier than P2 - P1 and within P2 + 1 s, with every output held; a new attach sees the reason
notes: The watcher is attached before the kill: the controller that is lost cannot report its own loss, so an independent stream has to observe the transition, and the status read and the plant read-back then confirm what it saw. The floor is P2 - P1, not P2: ADR-005 D4.4 has the core expire P2 after the last beat it received, and the gateway forwards a beat to the core at most once per P1, so the last beat before a SIGKILL is at most P1 stale and the earliest instant the runtime may safe-stop is P2 - P1 after the kill. P2 itself would be a floor the runtime could legitimately miss by up to P1, which is a false failure and not a tighter test.
